title_sq: Shitet papafingo te liqeni artificial me parkim+ depo
description_sq: Ne nje nga zonat me te preferuara dhe te qeta sic eshte Liqeni Artificial, shitet papafingo me nje siperfaqe prej 135 m2 te hipotekuara. Ka strukture 2+1 dhe eshte e organizuar me dy dhoma gjumi dhe nje super soxhorno te bukur me oxhak. Veranda qe ka te ofron nje pamje te mrekullueshme dhe relaksuese. Punimet e apartamentit jane mjaft cilesore ne cdo detaj duke filluar nga parketi, dyert, muret, dritaret, tavanet etj. Eshte me sistem ngrohje-ftohje. Ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje pallati me ashensor.
title_en: Loft for sale at the artificial lake with parking + storage
description_en: In one of the most preferred and quiet areas, such as the Artificial Lake, a mortgaged 135 m2 loft is for sale. It has a 2+1 structure and is organized with two bedrooms and a super beautiful living room with a fireplace. The veranda it has offers a wonderful and relaxing view. The works of the apartment are of high quality in every detail, starting from the parquet, doors, walls, windows, ceilings, etc. It has a heating-cooling system. It is located on the 3rd floor of a building with an elevator.
